formattedAddress: 100台灣臺北市中正區頂東里金門街4號

displayName.text: 咖啡學人-老傑克 The Cafeist & Old Jack

text.text:
喜歡這邊的熱拿鐵咖啡，平價，可集點的熟客服務。
也很推他們家的特調，有一點堅果的苦澀感。
內用位子少，適合靜靜喝一杯咖啡，調劑一下生活節奏感。

text.text:
🥨這家咖啡店是附近我蠻常去的一間，環境很舒服，氣氛也很好。
最喜歡他們的拿鐵，奶泡很綿密，咖啡喝起來順順的，不會苦也不酸，味道剛剛好，很順口。每次喝完心情都很好，算是生活裡的小確幸。

店裡不會太吵，適合一個人靜靜坐著，或是偶爾帶台電腦來換個環境。店員也很親切，整體感覺很放鬆自在。

如果剛好在附近，蠻推薦來喝杯咖啡，會是個不錯的休息時光。

This is one of the coffee shops I visit quite often in the neighborhood. The environment is cozy, and the atmosphere feels great.
I especially love their latte—the milk foam is really creamy, and the coffee is so smooth. It's not too bitter or sour, just perfectly balanced. Every time I finish a cup, it really lifts my mood. It feels like one of life's little joys.

The café is not too noisy, making it a great spot to sit quietly alone or bring a laptop to work for a while. The staff are also friendly, which makes the whole experience relaxing and pleasant.

If you're nearby, I definitely recommend stopping by for a cup of coffee—it’s a lovely little break in the day.

店內座位不多
